title: neomanniophyton zenkeri

It is traditionally used in African medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Neomanniophyton zenkeri include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and promoting wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds.
